ADMIN_NOT_FOUND: ℹ️ This user is not an admin.
ADMIN_PANEL: ⚙️ Control panel ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Choose what you want to do from the buttons below 👇
ASK_ADD: ➕ Add subscription Send the user ID (digits only). 💡 You can send the number of days right after the ID, for example: 123456789 30
ASK_ADD_ADMIN: 🛡 Add admin Send the ID of the person you want as admin.
ASK_ANALYZE: 🔍 Analyze video Send me the video and I will inspect it and tell you what to change, without modifying it.
ASK_BC: 📢 Broadcast Send the message you want delivered to all users (text, photo, video... anything).
ASK_CHECK: 🧪 Quality check Send the link of the published TikTok video and I will compare it with the last video I prepared for you (bitrate, resolution and quality similarity). Example: https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123...
ASK_DEL: ➖ Remove subscription Send the user ID whose subscription you want to remove.
ASK_DEL_ADMIN: 🗑 Remove admin Send the ID of the admin you want to remove.
BAD_ID: ❌ Invalid ID. Send digits only, or tap Cancel.
BAD_URL: ❌ That is not a valid TikTok link. Send a link from tiktok.com or vm.tiktok.com.
BUSY: ⏳ You already have a video being processed. Wait for it to finish, then send another.
CANCEL_DONE:
✅ Operation cancelled.
You can send a new video now 🎬
CMD_ANALYZE: Analyze a video without modifying it
CMD_CHECK: Check the quality of a published TikTok video
CMP_POP_ON: 🗜 On: upcoming videos are compressed to 1080p with a constant FPS before processing (re-encode, slightly lower quality).

DONE_SAFE: 🛡 Video integrity verified 100% (picture and audio untouched)
DONE_UPLOAD_TIP: 📥 Tap the file to download it, then upload it yourself on the TikTok Studio website.
DONE_WARNED: ⚠️ Please read the warning sent before this file.
FAIL: ❌ Something went wrong and I could not process the video. {reason}
FAIL_GENERIC: ❌ An unexpected error occurred during processing. Please try again.

NO_REF: ℹ️ I have no saved copy of a video I prepared for you (or it expired). Prepare a video first, then use /check.
NO_SUB: ℹ️ This user has no subscription.
OWNER_ONLY: ⛔ Access denied: only the developer can do this.

PE_REMUX_FAILED: Converting the format to MP4 failed
PE_TC_ALREADY: This video has already been processed; upload it to TikTok as it is instead of processing it again.
PE_TC_UNSUPPORTED: This option is not compatible with this file. Try Spark or Blaze.
PE_VERIFY_FIELDS: Verification failed: duration, FPS or codec changed after processing ({detail})
PE_VERIFY_FILE_MEDIA: File integrity check failed after processing: media bytes changed

Works with different FPS rates. 🔥 Blaze: an alternative if Spark does not give a suitable result. QR: 🧪 Quality check report ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📊 Bitrate: original {rb} → published {pb} 📉 Bitrate change: {bdiff} 📐 Resolution: original {rres} → published {pres}{res_mark} 📉 Resolution change: {res_diff} 🎞 FPS: original {rfps} → published {pfps} 📉 FPS change: {fps_drop} ⏱ Duration: original {rdur} → published {pdur} 🎬 Codec: {rcodec} → {pcodec} ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ {verdict}{note} Compared over the first {seconds} seconds. ℹ️ Compared against TikTok's published playback copy.
Q_EXCELLENT: Video quality ✅ Excellent — nearly identical to the original
Q_GOOD: Video quality 🟡 Good — a small difference, TikTok compressed it slightly
Q_POOR: Video quality 🔴 Poor — TikTok re-compressed the video heavily
REENC_COMPRESS: 🗜 Compressing the video (1080p, constant FPS)... This may take a while depending on the video length.
REPORT: 🔍 Video analysis ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎞 FPS: {fps:.2f} 📐 Resolution: {w}×{h} 🎬 Codec: {codec} ({depth}-bit) ⏱ Duration: {dur} • 📦 {mb:.1f} MB{bitrate} 🔊 Audio: {audio}{flags}
SEND_VIDEO_HINT: 🎞 Send me an MP4 video to prepare it, or tap one of the buttons below.
SUB_POPUP: 🔒 A subscription or one-video payment is required.
SUB_REMOVED_USER: ⚠️ Your subscription to the bot has ended. Contact the developer to renew.
TIP_10BIT: ℹ️ The video is 10-bit; if TikTok converts it oddly, export it as 8-bit.
TIP_AS_VIDEO: 📎 You sent the video as a “video” and Telegram may compress it before it reaches me. Better send it as a File to keep the original quality.
TIP_AUTO_REENC: 🔁 I will re-encode the video automatically to H.264 CRF {crf} before processing ({reasons}).
TIP_AV1: ⚠️ The codec is AV1. It will be prepared without re-encoding, but TikTok may treat it differently from H.264 and the result is not guaranteed. If a problem appears, try “Compress first”.
TIP_CODEC: ⚠️ The codec {codec} cannot be prepared directly (supported: H.264 / HEVC / AV1 / VP9). Use “Compress first” to convert it to H.264.
TIP_HDR: 🌈 The source video is HDR. With compression off, the bot does not re-encode the picture; TikTok may still change how it encodes or displays it.
TIP_HEVC: ℹ️ The codec is HEVC (H.265). It will be prepared without re-encoding. If problems appear, try “Compress first” or export H.264.
TIP_INFLATED: ♻️ The video looks already prepared (inflated sample tables). Do not process it again; upload it to TikTok directly.
TIP_LANDSCAPE: ↔️ The video is landscape. TikTok videos work best in vertical 9:16.
TIP_LINE: 💡 Before uploading: open TikTok settings and turn on “Allow high-quality uploads”.
TIP_LOW_BITRATE: 📉 The bitrate is low (~{mbps:.1f} Mbps) for this resolution. Raise it when exporting (15–30 Mbps) to keep detail.
TIP_MUSIC: 🎵 The audio contains metadata of a music track ({hints}). If the music is not from TikTok's commercial library or you have no license for it, the audio may be muted or publishing blocked. Use licensed audio or replace it.
TIP_RES: 📐 Resolution {w}×{h}. The best result comes from a 1920p (Full HD) source or higher.
TIP_RES_MAX: ⚠️ The resolution is above 4096 pixels; TikTok may reject or downscale it.
TIP_VP9: ⚠️ The codec is VP9 (usually from WebM/YouTube). It will be prepared without re-encoding, but the result is not guaranteed. If a problem appears, try “Compress first”.
TOO_BIG: ❌ The video is larger than the allowed limit Your video: {size} — maximum: {mb} MB. 💡 Trim the video or export it smaller and send it again.
WARN_NO_AUDIO: 🔇 Warning: the video has no audio track. I will continue, but this was not tested on silent videos so the result is not guaranteed.
WARN_VFR: ⚠️ The video is VFR (variable frame rate, about {fps:.1f} FPS). I will prepare it without re-encoding, but results with VFR are not guaranteed. Better export it with Constant Frame Rate or use the “Compress first” button.
